Local history log (builds from today)

The live API only shows current status plus the last event's start/end — it does not expose a queryable 6-month archive. This log fills that gap the only honest way possible: it snapshots what's discharging right now, every time you open this tool or click "Log snapshot", and stores it in this browser only. Leave it open during a rainy week, or check in every few days, and a genuine local history builds up over time.

For real historical data (not just from today)

Water companies don't publish a live 6-month archive, but this regulatory and campaign data goes back further:
EA Storm Overflow Annual Return
Official spill count & total duration per overflow, published annually (previous calendar year) — not day-by-day, but the authoritative regulatory record.
